notes.title: BIGGEST MAJOR UPDATE & NEW MAJOR EXPANSION IS COMING + FULL RELEASE DATE
notes.content:
[h2]Massive content are coming[/h2]

Empty your minds and lend me your eyes


[b]GPS[/b], a handheld portable device, satellite view of the entire region with potential paranormal places already marked by your HQ.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/0633202a2f1c29ae69631f7f2ee95b3ab23dd89e.jpg[/img]
It can also track when you have been and explored.
The GPS could still malfunction in high-activity areas, as all electronic devices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/f6333a94e25c8af332ad0a7197a649e9644866d4.jpg[/img]

[b]Lots of new major paranormal locations[/b] and places-of-interest are added in the woods.
They are interactive and coming in large and small sizes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/d3f17d648157d7f8b4fe57eb9b9b925651acccc4.jpg[/img]
You may come across aftermath of different places, to name a few, tourist camping site, cabins, or the witch, or stone formations with paranormal powers...
[h3]These locations also brings their own set of items,[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/3d19771c346da2ff6983fb00f63c604c4cf50f4c.jpg[/img]
[i]Yes, you can play with the ball in this picture.[/i]

For example you may find weapons, money stacks or [b]Portable Electricity Generator[/b] at a large camping site, pick it up and place it anywhere you need electricity, including inside the woods.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/9844942ca6591cd436300c7987e567317ff5e046.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/728539c3064e678e650b143beee6bfca5130756c.jpg[/img]

The woods will be rich with different interactable places and events, including [b]secrets behind puzzled entrance[/b], as all cursed woods should be.
Explore the woods and see where the rabbit hole takes you.

[h3]Water sources are more dangerous as Lakes are now a habitant of crocodiles.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/637eb88eda1fe3288e1c0886c1c282416a0b0260.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/09b22cc50e42fde897ca5652aecd04fe1a5546a7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/f6399e22975cebc792d0c459f9047d1b52629b9c.jpg[/img]

[h3]The Plot[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/ef558ec0996cdc3e6c0fdd141284983b3d67b7ed.jpg[/img]
[i]Welcome to Cinderfall Woods[/i]

Starting a new farm, will show a prologue of where you are, where you're coming from, and what has happened.
Discover what happened to the Cinderfall woods that plunged it into fog and darkness.

[h3]New Terrifying Entities[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/a688d6e567c49500159bde86e3b741b39732cf62.jpg[/img]
Including major ones, the witch, and her bodyguard.
You may encounter any of them anywhere anytime, as they roam their cursed land.
if you do you better run and hide.

Bigger Farm with the option to start there instead.
New farm animal, new crops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/2f764f289246b55602748843b4b1028dae0caf96.jpg[/img]

The farm app is finally installed and available in the computer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/973df7b9834e1b25235e4be2cdc28f71628193a5.jpg[/img]

New wildlife animals, Deer, Crocodile and boar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/2f60b10c2c86a1191fa6908655b476f1784ff8f9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/ce1af7d7a0544f9962d07aa678eef5bab8df1335.jpg[/img]

[h2]Female Character Addition[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/1f61d2abe738122dfb96eddde9c28dd67624394f.jpg[/img]
She'll be joining the haunt.

[h3]Mausoleums Expansion[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/e7910dcb190d0f5d467b482bb91a18b03e3831a2.jpg[/img]

The Mausoleums in the deep woods will be more [i]intense[/i] to explore! They are now filled with treasures, puzzles and [i]horror[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/67601b99d0661e694f596f6d9cbc39f78c66a1f3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/20ffaf8e832088f082ce103f87d2327cb1114ba7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/863d4c1c387282cf9da0621dc6c64125e892d5c4.jpg[/img]
Successful treasure extraction will reward you with $$$$.

[b]And the Biggest addition,[/b]
Aside from all above, we'll be getting a complete new game mode, that might deserve its own game.
[h2]Be part of the curse investigation team,[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/d35b47f72d7843058a0a4297fd649c7bcb76cee5.jpg[/img]

In this new mode, grab your EMFs, Blacklight and any gears along with a [b]Soil Measurement tool[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/b34178be6d2ff35ace7bd6842469bc5a001ef005.jpg[/img]

Go into a curse site in the woods, identify the curse using your tools, based on evidence, and get out (alive if possible).
don't forget your friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/1637d61e98c1d1adbc7ab0f3046780c84679853e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/636fba5f54db33d042b071ce55c58751331fa446.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/4234af9a0f065360eade6702d4f8dd3a345bf399.jpg[/img]

The curse sites are at initial stage before their climax, so they don't involve fog barriers or paranormal entities, [i]maybe[/i].
Things [b]could go wrong[/b] while you're investigating.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/923a9e825e508d4e735bcff7d1770cfdadb37f36.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/47c56d0fd7a0857494ede966c64db2b4a4b18cd5.jpg[/img]

This mode could take anywhere from 5 min to 30 min to complete.
15 types of curse, and 8 evidence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/56065d219c5dc6c3020cae7d4bf521f18cf41496.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/2dbe819cf23371b158f1b04dacf1fdc67b5544b8.jpg[/img]

And it's not just that, 
The update also brings more fixes and adjustments to the gameplay.

To conclude, this major update add tons of content, and we are getting out of the Early Access.

[h3]The full release is expected after this major update, a few weeks apart.[/h3]

JOIN US!

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE IS LIVE! - New Equipment & Night Events & Holidays
notes.content:
Howdy ho! 🎄🎁
Empty your minds and gaze upon this text,


[h2]NEW EQUIPMENTS[/h2]
A new shop just opened it's doors bringing paranormal investigators their tools to easily find and track their goals.
They h

There are 5 new devices all unique in their own ways. [b]They can be used to help with tracking and finding certain cursed objects[/b], Including abnormal activities, ghost signs, and anything that is paranormal in any way.

[h3]BLACK LIGHT[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/196c665c2b198bfce3a4712dd00489532a6a88d0.jpg[/img]
Used to [b]reveal[/b] ghost signs and ghost's footprints which points toward the direction of a cursed object.
If you happen to track an abnormal activity that has no physical appearances, check the surroundings with the UV light.

[h3]RADIO[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/4d76cff7d0973b80a4bde15c03aed530380092cd.jpg[/img]
Entry level for paranormal investigators, [b]Listen[/b] to frequency that are in your proximity, it displays how far or close your are to the source.

[h3]EMF[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/a32e12928277ef3c6d3f482ab6dce8f725f68d36.jpg[/img]
Bread and Butter of paranormal investigators, 5-lights indicator that determine how close you are to the source, as well as a beeping sound, the closer you are, the faster it beeps.

[h3]EMF METER[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/2d59a262bc95734660d61350b3a0fd3ee6e728e6.jpg[/img]
Similar to EMF but without the lights and the beeping, has a range of 120 meters and comes with a range changer, which is very useful in pin pointing the source.

[h3]PARABOLIC MICROPHONE[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/bee3711c11f1618d3fea285efd7c0d7b6dfe887f.jpg[/img]
The all-in-one solution, Built-in display with [b]detection meter[/b] and [b]speaker[/b].
Detects and [b]filter out[/b] only the activity it's been set to, for instance, curses only.
The detection is limited, it has to be pointed toward a source direction, but could pin-point the source from far away.
It's a little pricey, If you have a thousand bucks laying around in your farm, one can dream.


[h2]NIGHT EVENTS[/h2]
[b]Each night[/b] the curse could change things for your farm and the entire woods, some nights could be Heavy with paranormal activities whiles others calm with not activity at all.
You will know about the night at each [b]sunset[/b].

[list]
[*] [b]Blood moon[/b]
Heavy attack on the farm
[*] [b]Bright Moon[/b]
Low paranormal activity
[*] [b]Dark Moon[/b]
Near pitch-black everywhere
[*] [b]Calm Night[/b]
No paranormal activity, even the woods can be explored at midnight with no dangers, but the major entities will still roam their territory.
[*] [b]Normal Nights[/b]
As in a Normal night in the haunted woods, but with nothing extra.
[*] [b]More to come.[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/26e6a7d836db68d4424366b03ccfc84f9af20f39.jpg[/img]
[i]At sunset the major night event is known, here it's the "Blood Moon".[/i]

The woods become pitch-black at midnight, more dangerous. For those who lost their way back home, there is still hope as something "friendly" at midnight could find you before others do.

[h3]Also in the same update:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Glowstick and lighter performance has been improved
[*] Very low paranormal activity in the woods From 6 to 12 in the morning.
[*] Tax and Tip is no more in the shops
[*] New achievements "Path Angel" and "Ritual Book"
[*] Anything paranormal can be tracked using the new devices
[*] Shovel has been added to the Shop
[*] Shop Screens can be scrolled using the mouse wheel
[*] HDR is now supported and can be enabled in the VIDEO SETTINGS on supported displays.
[/list]

[h2]Planned for the next major updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bigger farm and farmhouse variant.
[*] [b]Investigation Work:[/b] Your farm could become haunted from those heavy paranormal night attacks. Investigate your farm to find clues and identify the haunter, Prepare based on it's type and exorcise it before your farm is cursed.
[*] [b]Large Building Blueprint:[/b] Designate an area for construction (e.g., a barn), then bring the necessary resources to build it.
[*] [b]And more[/b]
[/list]

[h3]STEAM DECK[/h3]
DTW is now playable on the Steam Deck. However the control will definitely needs to be find tuned.

notes.title: ADDED: AXE & BUILDING SYSTEM - FIRST MAJOR UPDATE
notes.content:
[h3]The First Major Update,[/h3]
Empty your minds and gaze upon this text (↓)

[b]The Major update is live![/b]

[h2]1. THE BUILDING SYSTEM[/h2]
[i]Place logs anywhere and start building your dream log house, with little to no limitations.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/8609a8dc10dc201d593685bc3011d6916309702e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/2f5327961c047f33e41672e59d179d3d3e17e6b6.jpg[/img]

[h2]2. THE AXE[/h2]
[i]Cut down trees, gather logs, and start building mighty home
The Axe can be both [b]crafted[/b] and  [b]found[/b].
For starters, one can be found at the [b]initial farm[/b], better axe can cut down trees faster.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/2ba6ea9295fd61ebc7bebeb7da8ed0e43b989b7f.png[/img]

[h2]3. WEATHER CHANGE[/h2]
[i][b]Snow[/b] will freeze the water ponds, cutting off access to the water source, better rack up those watering can.
[b]Rain[/b] will help with watering the crops, very beneficial when having many crops.[/i]

notes.title: Release Date Change + See What's Coming

[b]L[/b]et me just start by telling you that I'm aware I have no audacity in asking you to wait longer for release as it was changed twice already (21st, 23rd JUNE), 

[b]This time the release date is locked at July 12th[/b]
Now I'm aware that most of you if not all, were anticipating the release, even have planned ahead if you're a content creator, Please bear with me, the game will be in a better shape at the end of this time frame.

[b]T[/b]here are two reasons for the delayed release,
The first one is that I don't want to give you a game that isn't polished to a degree, 
The second reason is that the time it took for Steam to review the game until now, I came to an understanding that the title needs a little more time to being polished for release, thus the date-change to July 12th.
